name: IPTV Player (Enhanced)
description: IPTV Player with complete history and resume functionality: Live TV, VOD, Series, Favorites, Enhanced History with thumbnails, Resume position tracking with user prompts, Auto-reconnect with 'Remember Me', EPG, Search. FIXED: File-based persistent storage for history and resume positions (survives IINA restarts), Improved sync frequency (5s for better accuracy), Fixed history key for episodes (uses series_id to group episodes), Enhanced episode metadata parsing with better error handling.
